summary: Prevent false releases and publish nested Python packages

delivery.outcome: Goal aborts before publish, tagging or push when the release commit fails, refuses false success with no detected registry package, and publishes a nested Python package from its own root
nonGoals: No automatic GitHub release or registry retry policy change
No change to the repository's existing main-only delivery policy

architecture.decision: Propagate commit results through the push boundary, make empty project detection fail closed, and resolve nested Python build/publish commands to the discovered package root
interfaceChanges: _handle_commit_phase now returns a boolean commit result
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit before the next release; do not move or delete immutable release tag v0.20.43

validation.evidence: A failed release commit is returned to the workflow and blocks publish, tag and push stages
Empty project type detection cannot report a successful publish and nested packages/wellman is resolved
Existing artifact filtering and nested version discovery regressions remain green
Full tests, governance and whitespace checks pass before delivery
